comparisons.title: One publisher, two language accounts
comparisons.comparison_type: Manually selected same-publisher accounts of the same reported Paris meetings.
comparisons.observation: Both reports foreground the bank’s stated institutional outreach. Compare vocabulary, attribution and omitted or added context, without counting two independent witnesses.
comparisons.relationship_status: Topic/event correspondence manually reviewed; no translation_of or syndicated_from edge established.
comparisons.link_check: The English AR menu led to the Arabic homepage, not the Arabic article. A site language switch alone does not establish an article translation.
limits: Same publisher and same underlying statement.
Displayed clock times have no verified timezone; do not infer translation direction from them.

comparisons.title: Institutional outreach and household experience
comparisons.comparison_type: Cross-publisher, Arabic/English thematic comparison across different dates.
comparisons.observation: SANA’s Arabic account presents reported banking outreach; Syria Direct’s English feature asks how financial reconnection relates to household costs and practical access.
questions: What is attributed to official statements, and what is supported by reported interviews?
Which additional primary rules, datasets and follow-up reporting would test the respective claims?
limits: Shared broad topic, not the same event or publication date.
Selected articles cannot establish an outlet’s general ideology, coordination, influence or overall coverage.
The Syria Direct language switch and hreflang checks did not verify a corresponding Arabic article.
This comparison is an editorial reading exercise, not a measured media-effects result.

documents.title: Central Bank governor discusses reconnecting Syria to European banking system in Paris
documents.publication_display: 2026/10/31 8:49 PM; updated 9:31 PM; timezone not stated.
documents.document_type: News article relaying an institutional statement
documents.original_summary: SANA presents reported Paris banking meetings through the stated aims of institutional outreach and financial reconnection.
documents.evidence_locator: Article body paragraphs 1–4, particularly attribution to the bank statement.
limits: Reported aims and meetings are attributed to SANA and its cited bank statement; this is not independent verification of banking access or legal status.

documents.document_type: News article relaying an institutional statement
documents.original_summary: The Arabic report describes Paris meetings and attributes discussion of banking relationships and payments to the central bank’s public account.
documents.evidence_locator: Article body below the Paris dateline and the section on banking relationships.

documents.title: Syria reconnects to global finance, but ordinary Syrians are still struggling
documents.original_summary: Syria Direct considers financial reconnection alongside interviews about household costs and the practical obstacles Syrians face.
documents.evidence_locator: Headline, standfirst and opening reported interviews.
limits: The selected interview accounts are not a representative household survey. The article date differs from the selected SANA report.

method: Shared terms do not prove coordination, influence, agreement or causation.
An absent reference is not evidence that a publisher ignored a topic.
A source classification is not a reliability rating.
Two languages from one publisher do not create independent corroboration.
